license_note: BtbN FFmpeg-Builds win64 LGPL archive: it omits GPL-only components such as libx264, libx265 and libxvid, so the application can redistribute it. Bundled encoder options are chosen from the build's own encoder list by app/render.py; OpenH264 and VP9 are BSD, the native MPEG-4 Part 2 encoder is LGPL.
note: The download URL points at BtbN's moving 'latest' release. The pinned SHA-256 is checked on every fetch, so a silent upstream change fails the build with a clear re-pin message instead of shipping an unverified binary.
